title: Quarter-Wave Seeded 22-Layer Stack with Tightened Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: Initializing from analytic quarter-wave thicknesses at λ₀=550 nm with ±3 nm perturbation, combined with tightened [20,150] nm geometric bounds and reduced optimizer step-size, will recover and exceed the prior best target score of 0.9251 by constraining the search toward the physically motivated quarter-wave attractor while avoiding the thickness excursions that caused score regression.
design_principle: Quarter-wave baseline initialization provides a physically motivated starting point for local optimization; tightening bounds prevents unphysical thickness excursions that degrade dual-band performance.
proposed_topology: 22 finite layers alternating TiO2/SiO2 starting with TiO2 on fused silica substrate, terminated with SiO2. Exact sequence: TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2
soft_objectives: Maximize mean reflectance in 450-650 nm band
Maximize mean transmittance in 700-1000 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: All thicknesses bounded to [20,150] nm for deposition uniformity
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflection mirrors
Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference
expected_advantages: Reduced risk of thickness excursions causing score regression
known_risks: Quarter-wave initialization may constrain search away from non-quarter-wave optima
Tightened bounds may exclude valid high-performing thickness combinations
execution_request_english: Optimize a 22-layer TiO2/SiO2 dichroic coating on fused silica substrate at 45° incidence. Initialize all layer thicknesses from analytic quarter-wave values at λ₀=550 nm (TiO2 d_H≈52 nm, SiO2 d_L≈96 nm) with ±3 nm random perturbation. Apply hard geometric bounds [20,150] nm on all thicknesses. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with step-size multiplier reduced by 40% relative to baseline. Generate 12 candidate solutions. Evaluate target score as weighted combination of mean reflectance (450-650 nm) and mean transmittance (700-1000 nm). Layer sequence: TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2|TiO2|SiO2 (22 finite layers total). Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 450-650 nm, 700-1000 nm. soft objectives: high reflectance in 450-650 nm; high transmittance in 700-1000 nm; minimized crosstalk between bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 450-650 nm; reflectance in 700-1000 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 24 layers.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive: switched from uniform random initialization to quarter-wave seeded initialization at λ₀=550 nm, applied [20,150] nm thickness clamp, reduced optimizer step-size by 40%, increased candidate pool to 12. Addresses score regression from 0.9251 to 0.6864 by constraining search toward quarter-wave attractor.
